limitations_and_caveats: Observational telemetry correlation + temporal precedence strongly isolate the fault cohort (p < 1e-6), but definitive causal closure requires observing error rate decay after executing the rollback step.
Financial impact reflects direct failed checkouts/orders in the incident window and excludes secondary customer LTV churn.
